title: One core token contract (about 45 names) and a generated mapping per theme, with a pin that proves no value moves

source.ref: Theme cohesion sweep (docs/THEME-COHESION.md, ADR-1923). Owner picks 2026-10-29: role blocks and manifest, phased; no live site changes on its own.

detail: Shipped: lib/theme/block-contract-tokens.ts names the 45 core tokens (CORE_TOKEN_NAMES) and serves one generated mapping per theme (coreTokenMap, coreTokensCss) from lib/theme/block-contract-map.json, seeded from lib/sites/editor/theme-contract.json for names no sheet declares (frame, display weight). Each mapping is var(--existing) or a documented constant, so nothing a live site renders moves; the map is not emitted into any render yet (role blocks read it from LIVE-1857). lib/theme/block-contract-tokens.test.ts resolves every name against today's sheets for all nine themes (cascade-aware, Space accent and font set left symbolic) and pins the result; UPDATE_CONTRACT_MAP=1 regenerates the map. The --sk-* roles in components/sites/contract-skin-css.ts are untouched.

verify.note: Reads the wiring this row ships; fails on main. The behaviour is pinned by the row's own tests.
